# Capital Friends

> Capital Friends (https://capitalfriends.in) is a free, open-source family portfolio tracker for India. It tracks mutual funds, stocks, fixed deposits, PPF, EPF, NPS, gold and silver, property, insurance and loans for every family member in one dashboard, and keeps all the data in one Google Sheet in the user's own Google Drive. No bank or broker login, no server database, no ads, no paid tier.

- Who it is for: Indian families who want every member's money in one place without giving an app their bank or broker passwords, and people who want a tracker and planner rather than another investing app.
- Mutual funds: import each member's CAMS + KFintech consolidated account statement (CAS) PDF. Every purchase, SIP, switch, STP and redemption comes in with its real date; switches are not counted as new money, so money-in, XIRR and CAGR are correct per fund, portfolio, member and family. NAVs update daily from AMFI.
- Stocks: holdings from a broker Excel file or a CDSL/NSDL statement, per demat account; prices update daily.
- Everything else: fixed deposits, PPF, EPF, NPS, bonds, gold and silver by weight at today's rate, property, loans with EMI and months left, and insurance policies with nominees and a coverage check.
- Planning: a family net worth dashboard; funds below their own all-time high; target allocation with rebalancing by SIP split, lump sum or buy-and-sell; goal-based investing with a de-risk glide path; the three-bucket retirement strategy (Income: 2 years of expenses, Stability: the next 5 years, Growth: the rest) with refill rules for good, bad and recovery years; a financial health check.
- Family email: a daily or monthly email to the family members you choose, with where everything is.
- Privacy: the app reads and writes the user's own Google Sheet as the signed-in user. There is no server database and the developer cannot see the data. The sheet can be downloaded as Excel any time.
- Cost: free forever, no ads, no paid tier; voluntary donations only. Source code: https://github.com/jagadeeshkmanne/capital-friends
- Trade-offs: no direct link to banks, brokers or fund houses (data comes from statements, files or manual entry); a web app that works in mobile browsers, not a native app; India only; information and tracking only, not investment advice, and no investing through the app.
- Often compared with: INDmoney and Kuvera (investing apps that also track) and Value Research Online (fund research with a portfolio tracker). Capital Friends does tracking and planning only and can be used alongside any of them.
- Made by: Jagadeesh Manne, an Indian investor who built it for his own family and shares it free. Demo videos: https://www.youtube.com/@capitalfriendsin

## Guides
- [Your data in your own Google Drive](https://capitalfriends.in/your-data-in-your-google-drive/): No server, no bank login: one Google Sheet in your Drive holds everything.
- [Family members, bank and investment accounts](https://capitalfriends.in/family-members-and-accounts/): Everything belongs to a person; every platform is mapped to its bank.
- [Financial health check](https://capitalfriends.in/financial-health-check/): Seven yes/no questions most families miss, turned into action items.
- [CAMS CAS import](https://capitalfriends.in/cams-cas-import/): Get your consolidated statement and import every transaction.
- [Mutual fund portfolio tracker](https://capitalfriends.in/mutual-fund-portfolio-tracker/): All family funds from one CAS import, with real money-in, XIRR and CAGR.
- [Portfolio rebalancing: three ways](https://capitalfriends.in/portfolio-rebalancing/): Target allocation, drift, and rebalancing by SIP, lump sum or buy-and-sell.
- [Stock portfolio tracker](https://capitalfriends.in/stock-portfolio-tracker/): Family stock holdings from a broker Excel or CDSL/NSDL statement.
- [FDs, PPF, EPF, gold, property and loans](https://capitalfriends.in/track-fd-ppf-epf-gold-property/): Everything that is not a fund: gold by weight at today's rate, the house with its loan.
- [Insurance tracker with coverage check](https://capitalfriends.in/insurance-tracker/): Every policy with its nominee, and whether the cover is enough.
- [Goal-based investing with a glide path](https://capitalfriends.in/goal-based-investing/): Goals on a road, funded from the money you already have, moved to safety on time.
- [Retirement bucket strategy](https://capitalfriends.in/retirement-bucket-strategy/): Three buckets, refilled in good years, so you never sell in a crash.
- [Family net worth tracker](https://capitalfriends.in/family-net-worth-tracker/): Every member, every asset and loan, one dashboard, one number.
- [The daily family email](https://capitalfriends.in/family-financial-blueprint-email/): One email every morning: where everything is, for the people who would need it.
- [Free portfolio trackers compared](https://capitalfriends.in/best-free-portfolio-tracker-india/): Capital Friends, INDmoney, Kuvera and Value Research: what each is for, and when to pick which.

## Free calculators (no sign-in)
- [SIP calculator](https://capitalfriends.in/sip-calculator/): Monthly SIP → value after N years, with optional yearly step-up.
- [Lumpsum calculator](https://capitalfriends.in/lumpsum-calculator/): One-time investment → future value at a given return.
- [SWP calculator](https://capitalfriends.in/swp-calculator/): How long a corpus lasts with monthly withdrawals.
- [CAGR calculator](https://capitalfriends.in/cagr-calculator/): Annualised growth from a start value, end value and years.
- [XIRR calculator](https://capitalfriends.in/xirr-calculator/): Your real annual return from dated purchases and today's value.
- [Retirement corpus calculator](https://capitalfriends.in/retirement-corpus-calculator/): Corpus you need at retirement and the SIP to reach it.
- [Emergency fund calculator](https://capitalfriends.in/emergency-fund-calculator/): Months of expenses you should keep aside, and where.
- [FIRE calculator](https://capitalfriends.in/fire-calculator/): Your FIRE number and the age you can stop working.
- [Net worth calculator](https://capitalfriends.in/net-worth-calculator/): Assets minus loans, the number that shows real progress.

## Optional
- [Goal planner](https://capitalfriends.in/goal-planner/): plan retirement, child education or any goal, no sign-in
